track_a.scope: Six fixed technical cases; cached DF005/007/009R1 only
track_a.pit_policy: Exact decision-date KRX snapshot required; older verified identities separately diagnostic; no names-only joining
track_a.features: 20 matched observed prior sessions: median turnover, prior return, realized volatility; historical availability proof required
track_a.matching: Frozen DF011 distance and receipt/security hash tie; never match with incomplete inputs; never inspect post-entry returns
track_a.contamination: Decision-time original/correction coverage and fixed-set future audit; unknown remains unmatched; no future rematching
track_a.counts: Report independent stages and their intersection; zero observed cache coverage is not proof unavailable from provider

track_b.environment: PAPER only; official entitlement and quota evidence assessed separately from actual access
track_b.timestamps: Exchange seconds retained separately from UTC receipt/monotonic sequence; no invented exchange date or subsecond sequence
track_b.auction_policy: Exclude opening auction and unknown sessions from continuous-session range/VWAP; cumulative fields diagnostic only
track_b.corrections: Unavailable correction/cancel lineage UNKNOWN; detected correction or cumulative regression invalidates metrics
track_b.range_policy: Half-open [official regular open,open+5/15m); finalize only after receipt watermark and no observed defects; no claim of undetectable completeness
track_b.rvol: 20 prior clean same-exchange/elapsed-time sessions required; no history => RVOL_NOT_READY
track_b.fills: No simulated immediate signal-price fills; later-received, nonstale same-session quote evaluated separately, never guaranteed fill
track_b.quality: Retain duplicates; reject order inversion, counter regression, stale/crossed quotes; disconnect/gap taints range; VI/halt UNKNOWN unless official evidence
track_b.pilot_selection: DF005 cached 50-stock universe, last20 RAW observations through 2025-10-16, >=1e9 KRW median turnover, minimum SHA256(DF013:market:code); current validity separate prerequisite
track_b.cost_policy: Measured bytes/messages/latency/rate/fees/labor remain NULL without actual collection; caps are limits not measured forecasts
track_b.continue_gate: Offline infrastructure may pass; pilot supply ready requires official scope plus explicit authentication/streaming approval; unavailable PAPER never falls back to LIVE

semantic_contract: Separate proposed MARKET_PURCHASE_D1_V2 subtype; no old D1 modification or new economic test
